Works

# Philosophy quotes by work

A quotation's most useful address is the passage it occupies, so the archive is organised around works as well as thinkers. Each work page lists its passages in order, names the edition and translator where the corpus records them, and explains the locator system — Stephanus numbers, Bekker numbers, book and verse — that makes every passage findable in any printing.
